freeze_context: Before V2 market results; no candidate selected and no confirmation calculation or new data acquisition in this subtask
authorization: Current user-authorized optimization and BTC/ETH perpetual research; old spot #139/#155 calendars confer no authority

scope.exchange: Binance USD-M provisional research source; execution venue unconfirmed

window.warmup_use: Price features only; no scored warmup returns. Some warmup hours are still future at freeze and are not claimed acquired.
window.terminal_accounting: Exit existing positions under frozen rules, force remaining virtual position at end boundary with actual boundary open after publication. Preserve native actual force-exit timestamp if data ends earlier; do not relabel one-hour-early exit as end-boundary execution.
window.missed_activation: NOT_ACTIVATED_MISSED_START; never backdate candidate registration or silently roll start. A later window requires a pre-start versioned protocol, with this missed window retained.

historical_windows.evidence: docs/research-knowledge/btc-eth-1000-central-v1.json windows; not opened by this protocol
Scoped audit is not a proof of universal historical freedom; no unreviewed past window admitted

candidate_selection.eligibility: One retained native shared-wallet run with reconciled fees/funding and positive full-development net USDT under complete 8bp/side cost. Exposed 2026 diagnostics are disclosed, never holdout. Any unavailable native semantics or unverified accounting blocks selection.
ranking: Highest full-development net USDT among eligible candidates
If net differs by <=1 USDT, lower turnover notional
If still tied, shorter exit channel
candidate_selection.risk: About 20% is a diagnostic target. A result slightly above target is not disqualified. Development drawdown >=30% mandates RISK_RECALIBRATION_REQUIRED before activation; 30% is a conservative mandatory review trigger, not accepted real-account risk or an economic pass threshold. Recalibration must be frozen and fully recalculated before future start, otherwise no activation.
candidate_selection.if_none: NO_COST_SUPPORTED_CANDIDATE; no confirmation activation, no forced replacement. Preserve future-window reservation and report the inactive state.
candidate_selection.freeze_rule: Choose once using development only before start. Do not switch winners, retune exits/factors, add coins, or use this confirmation outcome to select the candidate.

time_and_data.features: Completed OHLCV and only available_at <= decision time. Preserve event_time, available_at, fetched_at, source_version, quality and observed raw response SHA. No full-sample fitting.
time_and_data.signal_timing: Keep the selected native strategy timing: source candle t planned entry no earlier than t+2h. A durable signal/NO_TRADE record must exist before planned entry; available inputs and formulas must be hash-bound. Missing/late observation is not a retroactively timely signal.
time_and_data.evidence_grade: Precommitted future signals evaluated with native offline fill assumptions can establish future economic evidence; they do not establish actual fills, live execution, or protection timing. Future data with only late replay remains FUTURE_DATA_DELAYED_REPLAY_ONLY, not this protocol primary confirmation.
time_and_data.scheduler_gate: 30-minute heartbeat alone does not prove signal capture. Before activation, exercise actual incremental data->feature->precommitted signal->native reconciliation on a non-scoring interval with durable timestamps and single writer.
time_and_data.missing: At a missing decision do not open new virtual risk; record the omission immediately. Never drop losing/missing dates based on later outcomes. Report all scheduled decisions and a same-availability comparator. Unknown execution/valuation/funding while a position is open blocks complete primary net equity until bounded reconstruction is explicitly separated; never zero-fill funding.
time_and_data.sensitive_features: Only selected frozen price/risk inputs in primary confirmation. OI/onchain values may be archived prospectively but cannot be added to the confirmed candidate. Revised non-PIT onchain history never inherits independent status.

cost_and_wallet.native_engine: Pinned Freqtrade, one shared wallet, two pairs, 1x isolated research assumption. Preserve full lifecycle peak and fees/funding.
cost_and_wallet.funding: Actual settled events and mark, signed cash flow once per held amount; preserve milliseconds and declared same-timestamp event-before-fill order.
cost_and_wallet.stress: Additional 4bp/side conditional same-fill arithmetic only; report separately, not independent samples or full account rerun.
cost_and_wallet.risk_observation: Hourly mark-to-market equity includes open PnL, fees and funding. Intrahour drawdown remains UNKNOWN unless separately verified. Current contract filters are not historical PIT.

sample_and_decision.opportunity_unit: Complete native position episodes and synchronized BTC/ETH 72-hour blocks anchored at window start. Same block across coins and multiple cost scenarios are not independent samples.
sample_and_decision.sample_rationale: A modest predeclared planning floor across 90 days, not an industry standard or a guarantee of statistical power. Fewer natural opportunities yield UNDERPOWERED; no trades are manufactured and no fixed annual trade quota applies.
sample_and_decision.uncertainty: Report concentration, exposure, duration, tails and block dependence. If feasible report synchronized 72h block bootstrap 95% interval using a preregistered fixed seed, 2000 resamples; show estimator limits. CI unavailable remains UNKNOWN and never becomes a fabricated significance claim.
precedence: Data/accounting/execution-semantic failure -> BLOCKED_DATA or BLOCKED_RUNTIME; economic metrics unavailable stay NULL
Fewer than 12 nonempty synchronized blocks or timely coverage below 95% -> UNDERPOWERED; keep descriptive economic sign separately
Adequate observations and gross price effect <=0 -> GROSS_NOT_SUPPORTED
Adequate observations, gross positive, base net <=0 -> COST_NOT_SUPPORTED
Adequate observations and base net >0 -> CONFIRMATION_POSITIVE_LIMITED; stress negative adds COST_SENSITIVE, it is not a universal profitability claim
sample_and_decision.risk_dimension: Independently report WITHIN_TARGET / ABOVE_TARGET_REVIEW / RISK_RECALIBRATION_REQUIRED. 20.1% or 21% is not an automatic economic fail; >=30% requires recalibration review and cannot graduate. Report DD duration/tail/exposure and uncertainties at every level.
sample_and_decision.calendar_end: Generate terminal report at fixed end even when samples are insufficient; no automatic extension. A subsequent independent window is a new predeclared budget, never relabeling or appending until positive.

bootstrap_spec.series: One frozen shared-wallet hourly log-return series; resample the 30 complete nonoverlapping 72h blocks with replacement. Include zero-exposure blocks.
bootstrap_spec.estimand: Conditional realized-path 90-day compounded return, not a new native account execution or probability of future profit.
bootstrap_spec.unknown_rule: Any missing primary equity blocks or nonpositive equity makes this estimator unavailable; report UNKNOWN rather than selectively dropping blocks.

reporting_and_scheduler_provenance.immediate_reports: Persist technical blockers, budget end and final economics in Chinese Markdown plus machine summary; next direction exactly one with actual queued/waiting/inactive ID.
reporting_and_scheduler_provenance.interim: Health/data status may be read; no candidate replacement, threshold tuning or repeated PnL-driven decisions within confirmation.
reporting_and_scheduler_provenance.current_optimization_trigger: USER_STEERED_EXPLICIT_OPTIMIZATION; not evidence of heartbeat execution
reporting_and_scheduler_provenance.proof_rule: Only scheduler/provider metadata that identifies the trigger may prove automatic execution. Prompt similarity, elapsed 30 minutes, ACTIVE config or a user-started tick do not. If trigger origin is unavailable record UNKNOWN; do not derive it from cadence.
